تحتموا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَمُوا (taḥtamū) /taħ.ta.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# تُحْتَمَوْا (tuḥtamaw) /tuħ.ta.maw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
